name: Elizabeth
source:
Your [url=/c176064]mom[/url]’s sister, auntie Liz, is a fierce woman. She lives very close by. She is married to a weak man named [url=/c176075]Albert[/url]. Your auntie emasculates her husband Albert every chance he gets and makes fun of his lack of sexual virility and skills in public with no shame. It turns out she was doing much worse in private settings.

[In game description]
